title: LANCache
description: The game download cache, from its nginx access log in Loki. docs/design/lancache.md, "Logs and hit rate".

panels.title: Hit ratio, requests
panels.description: HIT over every request nginx answered from or through its cache, over the dashboard range. With slicing, each 1 MiB slice of a download is its own entry, but one client request is one line.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status | upstream_cache_status="HIT" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status | upstream_cache_status!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Hit ratio, bytes
panels.description: Bytes served from cache over all bytes served through it, over the dashboard range: the share of game downloads that did not cross the uplink.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status, bytes_sent | upstream_cache_status="HIT" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status, bytes_sent | upstream_cache_status!="" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range]))

panels.title: Bytes served, by cache status
panels.description: Total response bytes over the dashboard range. HIT came from the dataset; MISS crossed the uplink once and was written to it.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream_cache_status) (sum_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status, bytes_sent | upstream_cache_status!="" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests by cache status
panels.description: Access-log lines per interval; the unnamed series is requests answered without the cache. The kube-probe and image heartbeats are dropped before Loki, so an idle cache reads empty.

panels.title: Throughput by cache status
panels.description: Response bytes per second. nginx logs a request when it completes, so a long download lands as one spike at its end.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream_cache_status) (rate({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json upstream_cache_status, bytes_sent | upstream_cache_status!="" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__auto]))

panels.title: Bytes by service
panels.description: The image's cache identifier (steam, epicgames, ...) from uklans/cache-domains, or the Host for a name it does not map.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cache_identifier, upstream_cache_status) (sum_over_time({namespace="lancache", container="access-log"} | json cache_identifier, upstream_cache_status, bytes_sent | upstream_cache_status!="" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range])))

panels.title: Responses by HTTP status
panels.description: A run of 5xx is the upstream CDN or UPSTREAM_DNS failing; check the error log below.
